alt: Poster: Sensex down 0.39% as three-day winning run ends; Nifty 50 near 25,144; Realty top laggard (closing data, 13 Nov 2026)
text:
Indian equities snapped a three-day winning run on Friday, with realty the weakest sector.

• The BSE Sensex fell 0.39% (about 319 points), ending a three-day gain run, per Business Standard and Liquide market reports.
• The NSE Nifty 50 closed near 25,144, down about 0.6%, staying above the 25,000 mark, per Business Standard and Liquide.
• Nifty Realty was the top sectoral laggard, per Business Standard and Liquide.
• Business Standard also noted India VIX was down about 7% on the day.

Our view: one down session after three gains is a small move in context, and a single day says little about direction. It may simply reflect a pause after a recent run, but the data alone cannot tell us why. This is an opinion on what the numbers may mean, not a prediction.

For practitioners: after a short winning streak, do you review client allocations at set intervals, or only when a trigger event occurs?
